Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def f(inp):
    g=[r[:] for r in inp]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    rows4=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if any(x==4 for x in r)]
    r0=min(rows4); r1=max(rows4)
    new=[row[:] for row in g]
    # vertical flip of the 4-shape, copied directly below it
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):
        ni=r1+1+(r1-i)
        if ni<H:
            for j in range(W): new[ni][j]=g[i][j]
    return new
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    print(k, f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
res=f(G['Test input'])
print(json.dumps(res))

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    T=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',T):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        segs=[r.split() for r in T[m.end():].split('\n')]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in segs[:h]):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in segs[:h]]
    return G
G=load()
def f(inp):
    g=[r[:] for r in inp]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cells=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==4]
    rs=[p[0] for p in cells]; cs=[p[1] for p in cells]
    r0,c0=min(rs),min(cs)
    h=max(rs)-r0+1; w=max(cs)-c0+1
    new=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i,j in cells: new[i][j]=4
    # direction toward the 6-marker (dominant axis)
    mk=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==6]
    mr,mc=sum(p[0] for p in mk)/len(mk),sum(p[1] for p in mk)/len(mk)
    cr,cc=(max(rs)+r0)/2,(max(cs)+c0)/2
    if abs(mr-cr)>abs(mc-cc): dr=h; dc=0
    else: dr=0; dc=w
    for i,j in cells:
        ni,nj=i+dr,j+dc
        if ni<H and nj<W: new[ni][nj]=4
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]==6: new[i][j]=0
    return new
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    print(k, f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
res=f(G['Test input'])
print(json.dumps(res))

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        segs=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in segs[:h]):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in segs[:h]]
    return G
G=load()

    cells=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==4]
    mk=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==6]
    rs=[p[0] for p in cells]; cs=[p[1] for p in cells]
    c_r,c_c=(min(rs)+max(rs))//2,(min(cs)+max(cs))//2
    mr=sum(p[0] for p in mk)/len(mk); mc=sum(p[1] for p in mk)/len(mk)
    h=max(rs)-min(rs)+1; w=max(cs)-min(cs)+1
    new=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i,j in cells: new[i][j]=4
    # reflection along axis perpendicular to approach direction through midpoint between shape center and marker centroid
    out=[]
    for v in (0,1):
        for hf in (0,1):
            J=set()
            if v: J={(c_r-(i-c_r),j) for i,j in cells}
            elif hf: J={(i,c_c-(j-c_c)) for i,j in cells}
            else: J=cells
            # mirror about the line midway between shape and marker centroids
            if abs(mr-c_r)>abs(mc-c_c):  # marker below/above -> vertical flip then shift along row

                for i,j in J:

                    nj=j
                    pass

            pass
    # Instead: derive dr/dc from demo geometry directly
    dr = mr - max(rs)   # shift so copy bottom reaches marker top? test later
    dc = 0
    return new,dr,dc

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        segs=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in segs[:h]):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in segs[:h]]
    return G
G=load()

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    mcells=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==6]
    scells=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==4]
    mr=min(i for i,_ in mcells); mr2=max(i for i,_ in mcells)
    mc=min(j for _,j in mcells); mc2=max(j for _,j in mcells)
    sr=min(i for i,_ in scells); sr2=max(i for i,_ in scells)
    ss=min(j for _,j in scells); ss2=max(j for _,j in scells)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    # clear marker
    for i,j in mcells: out[i][j]=0
    # determine direction: compare bbox centers
    cr=(sr+sr2)/2; cc=(ss+ss2)/2
    cmr=(mr+mr2)/2; ccc=(mc+mc2)/2
    if abs(cmr-cr)>abs(ccc-cc):
        # vertical
        if cmr>cr:   # marker below -> place below, vflip
            h = sr2-sr+1
            o = []
            for i,j in reversed(scells): o.append((i+h, j))
            for p in o: out[p[0]][p[1]]=4
        else:         # marker above -> place above? unknown; skip
            pass
    else:
        if ccc>cc:   # marker right -> hflip, shift right by width? 
            w = ss2-ss+1
            o=[]
            for i,j in scells: o.append((i, j+w))
            for p in o: out[p[0]][p[1]]=4
        else:
            # marker left -> hflip, shift left? unknown
            w=ss2-ss+1
            o=[(i,j-w) for i,j in scells]
            for p in o: out[p[0]][p[1]]=4
    return out

def solve(grid):
    import os,re,json as j
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
    def find():
        rows=[]; 
        for m in re.finditer(r'Test input \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
            h,w=int(m[1]),int(m[2])
            rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
            if all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows): break
        return [[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    g=find()
    cells=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==4]
    marker=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==6]
    # direction: relative of first marker cell to shape bbox center
    ib=min(i for i,j in cells); iB=max(i for i,j in cells)
    jb=min(j for i,j in cells); jB=max(j for i,j in cells)
    cy,cx=(ib+iB)/2,(jb+jB)/2
    mr=min(i for i,j in marker); maxm=max(i for i,j in marker)
    mc,minm=min(j for i,j in marker); maxm2=max(j for i,j in marker)
    dc,dr = (mc-cx)>0-(mc-cx)<0, (mr-cy)>0-(mr-cy)<0
    S={(i+dr*3,j+dc*3) for i,j in cells}  # offset toward marker by ~bbox size
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i,j in S:
        if 0<=i<len(out) and 0<=j<len(out[0]): out[i][j]=4
    for i,j in cells: out[i][j]=0
    for i,j in marker: out[i][j]=0
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    gi=G[k+' input']
    try: res=solve(gi); print(k,'MATCH' if res==G[k+' output'] else 'FAIL')
    except Exception as e: print(k,e)

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    S={(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==4}
    M={(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==6}
    rmin=min(i for i,_ in S); rmax=max(i for i,_ in S)
    cmin=min(j for _,j in S); cmax=max(j for _,j in S)
    mr=min(i for i,_ in M); mc=max(j for _,j in M)
    # choose dominant axis: vertical extent of gap vs horizontal
    dy = mr - rmax          # positive => marker below
    dx = mc - cmax          # positive => marker right
    if abs(dy) >= abs(dx):
        flip=lambda i,j:(-i,j)
        loff=(rmax+1-rmin, 0)   # reflected rows: rmin->rmin+? handle carefully below
        out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
        for i,j in S: out[i][j]=4
        R={(rmax-(i-rmin), j) for i,j in S}  # reflect over horizontal center
        dr=loff[0]; dc=loff[1]
        for i,j in R:
            ii=i+dr; jj=j+dc
            if 0<=ii<H and 0<=jj<W: out[ii][jj]=4
        for i,j in M: out[i][j]=0
        return out
    else:
        flip=lambda i,j:(j,i)   # placeholder; will not use for test
        R={(j, rmax-(i-rmin)) for i,j in S}  # reflect over vertical center
        out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
        for i,j in S: out[i][j]=4
        loff=(0, cmax+1-cmin)
        for i,j in R:
            ii=i; jj=j+loff[1]
            if 0<=ii<H and 0<=jj<W: out[ii][jj]=4
        for i,j in M: out[i][j]=0
        return out
# Verify all demos
ok=[]
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5']:
    ok.append((k, f(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output']))
print(ok)
res=f(G['Test input'])
print(json.dumps(res))

    out=[[x for x in row] for row in g]
    r0=min(i for i,j in cells); c0=min(j for i,j in cells)
